record.summary: The selected 187-line hair facade declares modules and reexports and contains no local producer implementation. Its no_run example was source text only. In connected current source, Look::guides casts a signed HairSeed word to u64 before calling Hairdo::guides. The optional GPU host route places the same cast in Guides::Hairdo, and its record_guide_roots path calls the shared guide_key separately. Hairdo accepts the wider u64 domain and its guide key mixes both 32-bit halves. HairSeed::from_word separately stores the low 32-bit pattern zero-extended in Seed, while casting a negative i32 directly to u64 sign-extends it. The high hash input therefore differs if the canonical stored word replaces that cast for a negative seed; whether a typed owner should propagate, adapter placement, all callers and actual behavior are open.

record.classification: The selected producer adds equipment-contact owners to party, sorts and truncates party to sixteen, but retains equipment contacts independently. The native validator rejects a retained contact whose owner is absent from the retained party if earlier checks pass. A validated roster is nonempty, unique and at most sixteen, yet these displayed accumulator and enrollment windows do not establish that every possible contact owner belongs to that roster. Supported reachability and native outcomes remain open.
record.relationship_qualification: q3128 already records the sort/truncate versus retained-contact first operation under Root Lens3; this is connected 95e producer support, not a newly counted independent defect. q3127 addresses lifecycle/native callback admission separately. Do not infer a shared alias, infinite retry or observed participant loss.
record.connected_repair_direction: Trace actual authorized roster, every party/contact accumulator writer, validation and retry semantics before deciding how the same receipt contract should be owned or preserved.
record.future_acceptance: Only after audit and separate authorization, preserve authorized consequences, contact ownership, native receipt bounds and frozen retry semantics.

record.classification: A signed i32 HairSeed is cast directly to u64 for selected CPU and GPU host guide calls, while its canonical Seed storage zero-extends the i32 bit pattern via u32. For negative words these representations have different high 32-bit halves, which guide_key feeds into the hash. Public Hairdo::guides accepts arbitrary u64; replacing this boundary with the canonical seed word would alter an input to the key, so a future owner propagation decision needs an explicit bit-preservation policy.
record.relationship_qualification: Bounded source-derived behavior-preservation question related to existing hair seed owners, not an established wrong product result or an accepted unique-defect count. Operation seed-offset arithmetic has a distinct first operation; alias and repair grouping remain open.
record.connected_repair_direction: Trace all guide entry points, owner and public-domain constraints before selecting an adapter; preserve signed widening and distinct 64-bit callers unless a separately authorized policy changes them.
record.future_acceptance: Only after audit and authorization, assess CPU/GPU and public boundary seed representation and deterministic key semantics without assuming these source paths have executed.
